<!-- Write the title and body in English. Remove prompts when filling this out. -->

## Summary

Describe the source problem and the focused changes that address it.

## Outcome

Describe the resulting behavior, including a before/after example when useful. Explain how the change satisfies the source Issue; identify any intentionally partial scope.

## Validation

List the checks actually performed and their results, including failures. Identify skipped or unperformed checks and explain why. Choose checks appropriate to the changed files and existing repository tooling. Separate optional checks from mandatory pre-merge acceptance.

## Required post-merge verification

List genuinely necessary checks possible only after merge as pending, or state that none are required. Do not claim deployment or publication succeeded based on pre-merge validation.

## Related issues

Link the source Issue and other relevant Issues. Use `Closes #<number>` only when the implementation fully addresses that Issue.
